memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Epilepsy: status – stable on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD, no breakthrough seizures in past 3 months. plan – continue current regimen, counsel on medication adherence and seizure diary, arrange EEG and basic metabolic labs, review in 3 months.
- Weight: 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female, cut‑off 80 cm) – slightly increased. plan – advise reduced refined carbs, increase walking to 30 min daily, re‑measure at next visit.
- Due: HbA1c not indicated (no diabetes); next review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Prescription issued: Levetiracetam 500 mg tablet, 1-0-1 (after food); Lamotrigine 50 mg tablet, 1-0-1 (after food). Continue current doses. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Front desk booked a follow‑up visit for epilepsy management with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) on 2025-07-01 at 10:30 am. Patient confirmed via SMS reminder.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum Sodium: 138 mmol/L (Ref: 135-145).
Serum Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (Ref: 0.5-1.1).
Both within normal limits.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: awake and sleep study shows no epileptiform discharges; background activity normal for age. No focal slowing. Interpretation: no electrographic evidence of seizure activity at this time.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Patient messaged via clinic app: ‘Over the past two weeks I have had three brief staring episodes lasting 10‑15 seconds each, not responding to verbal cues. No injury. Concerned about breakthrough seizures.’

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Epilepsy: status – patient reports three recent staring episodes suggestive of breakthrough seizures; medication levels unchanged. plan – increase levetiracetam to 750 mg BD, maintain lamotrigine 50 mg BD, counsel on seizure precautions, repeat labs in 6 weeks, review in 8 weeks.
- Weight: 69 kg, waist 85 cm – mild central adiposity. plan – reinforce low‑glycemic diet, add 15‑minute brisk walk after meals.
- Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 8 weeks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Prescription updated: Levetiracetam 750 mg tablet, 1-0-1 (after food); Lamotrigine 50 mg tablet, 1-0-1 (after food). Continue. Review in 8 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum Sodium: 137 mmol/L (Ref: 135-145).
Serum Creatinine: 0.88 mg/dL (Ref: 0.5-1.1).
Both stable and within normal range after levetiracetam dose increase.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Dr S. Rao (Consultant Neurologist) for evaluation of refractory seizure episodes despite medication adjustment. Requested EEG video monitoring and consideration of therapeutic drug levels. Please advise on further management.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurology report: Video EEG showed no capture of events; intermittent generalized slowing noted. Suggested checking levetiracetam serum level (target 5-15 µg/mL) and consider adding clobazam if levels adequate. Return to endocrinology for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Epilepsy: status – patient reports no further staring episodes since August; medication adherence good. plan – maintain levetiracetam 750 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, check levetiracetam level if available, continue seizure diary, review in 4 months.
- Weight: 70 kg, waist 86 cm – slight increase. plan – dietary review focusing on portion control, encourage swimming twice weekly.
- Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 4 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Prescription adjusted: Levetiracetam 750 mg tablet, 1-0-1 (after food); Lamotrigine increased to 100 mg tablet, 1-0-1 (after food). Continue. Review in 4 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum Sodium: 136 mmol/L (Ref: 135-145).
Serum Creatinine: 0.90 mg/dL (Ref: 0.5-1.1).
Both within normal limits; no renal or electrolyte concern.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Front desk rescheduled the follow‑up endocrinology visit from 2026-10-05 to 2026-09-20 at 09:00 am due to patient’s work schedule change. Confirmation sent via clinic app.
